summary: Bundle I / Phase 1 ORAi per-Center AI assistant tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 15/16 pytest cases passed (1 skipped due to activity route path; activity logging visually confirmed on classic dashboard 'Recent Activity' widget showing '@stealth started an ORAi conversation' entries). Frontend: classic dashboard header ORAi button, ?orai=1 auto-open, prompt chips, typed input, multi-turn assistant replies, session switching, New (+), delete-with-confirm, close, disclaimer, bold markdown rendering, and mobile full-width panel all work. Hub (rc-hub-orai) shows 4 insights and 'Open AI Assistant' navigates. rc-search-panel confirmed present on classic dashboard (regression pass). ONE FRONTEND BUG: edu-orai-fab at bottom-right (y=832, right=20px) is overlapped by the mobile-style bottom navigation 'Profile' tab — clicking it navigates to /profile instead of opening ORAi panel. JS click on the FAB works fine (panel opens correctly), and the sidebar 'AI Teaching' entry works. So the ORAi feature itself is fine; only the FAB z-index/position needs fixing.

minor.issue: Route path 'activity' not exposed for regular members (returned 404); activity logs live under /rc-admin/centers/{cid}/activity. Not a blocker — orai_session_started entries ARE created (visible on classic dashboard 'Recent Activity' widget).

ui_bugs.issue: edu-orai-fab (fixed bottom-5 right-5, z-40) is obscured by the app's bottom navigation bar (bottom-profile button). document.elementFromPoint at the FAB center returns the bottom-nav Profile button, so a real user click on the sparkles FAB navigates to /profile instead of opening the ORAi panel. JS click still opens the panel correctly.

issues: FAB needs bottom offset (e.g. bottom-24 md:bottom-5) or higher z-index (>= 60) to clear the bottom nav on viewports where the bottom nav is rendered.

action_items: Fix edu-orai-fab overlap with bottom navigation: raise z-index above the bottom nav OR increase bottom offset so the sparkles button is tappable (currently swallows to Profile tab). Suggested: className '... bottom-20 md:bottom-5 z-[60] ...'.
(Optional) Consider exposing /api/responsibility-center/{cid}/activity read for members (currently only /rc-admin path).
critical_code_review_comments: rc_orai._center_context correctly gates: vault balance only shown with view_vault, non-managers only see their own items (q['assignee_ids'] = user['id']). Good permission isolation.

System prompt includes explicit compliance rules (Fire Power = engagement resource, no medical/legal/financial/accreditation claims, suggest-only). Live compliance test passed — model refused to advise selling FP.
call_openai_chat is awaited; messages persisted after reply; session updated_at refreshed. Clean.
delete_session correctly scoped by user_id and center_id in the delete filter — cross-user deletion returns 404 as verified.
Minor: MAX_HISTORY=20 truncation happens after full read of 200 messages — small perf hit but not critical.
test_credentials: stealth / Password1$ (founder, edu owner); tftwo / pass1234 (non-member).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 ORAi session via chat + delete during backend test. During frontend testing 2-3 additional live ORAi sessions were created on the education center (real OpenAI calls, ~5-7 chat calls total).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ORAi backend + panel UI are green. Only issue is edu-orai-fab is under the bottom nav on desktop viewport (1440x900) — need z-index bump or higher bottom offset. When re-testing, don't rely on force=True click alone; either scroll into view + normal click or verify document.elementFromPoint at the FAB center returns the FAB (not bottom-profile). Real OpenAI chat calls cost money — reuse the created_session_id fixture pattern.
